title.en: Give the inspection station a comparison

t.zh: 你接手一台图像质检台。它能拍摄工件，却还不会比较、去干扰或找出轮廓。你将从读数开始造比较仪，再装出扫描器与频率分析仪；每次通过的电路，都会成为后续机器能复用的部件。
t.en: You inherit an image inspection station. It captures items but cannot yet compare them, suppress nuisance or measure contours. Build a comparator, then a scanner and frequency analyser. Each passed circuit becomes a reusable part.

t.zh: 先造比较部件：把同一位置、同一通道的观测与参照对应起来。这里光照固定、图像已对齐；点击图格查看位置与原始读数。数值计算由电路完成，不要求手算。 <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>
t.en: First compare observations and references at matching positions and channels. Lighting is fixed and images are aligned. Select cells to inspect positions and original readings. The circuit does the arithmetic. <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 差异图保留变化位置；绝对值兼顾变亮和变暗。它仍不能自行区分缺陷、错位与光照变化。 <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Differences localise change; absolute value retains brightening and darkening. They do not by themselves identify defects, motion or lighting. <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 先保留变化方向：参照变为观测时，逐格输出观测减参照。
brief.en: First retain direction: output observation minus reference at matching cells.

naiveWhy.zh: 正号表示比参照更亮，负号表示更暗。交换两张图会交换方向。
naiveWhy.en: Positive is brighter than the reference; negative is darker. Swapping images reverses direction.

hint.zh: 先观察一个变亮和一个变暗的位置。数值计算自动完成。
hint.en: Inspect one brighter and one darker location. Arithmetic is automatic.

brief.zh: 质检同时关注变亮和变暗。输出每格变化的大小；相同位置输出 0。
brief.en: Inspection must retain both brightening and darkening. Output change size at each cell; unchanged cells give 0.

naiveWhy.zh: 带符号的差会把变暗显示为负值，不能直接当作变化大小。
naiveWhy.en: Signed differences retain negative darkening; they are not change magnitudes.

hint.zh: 沿用刚才的差异电路，考虑怎样保留大小而忽略方向。
hint.en: Reuse your signed comparison and consider retaining size without direction.

t.zh: 带正负号的差已经保留了变化方向。现在质检同时关心变亮和变暗；新的绝对值元件保留数值大小，让两类变化都进入比较结果。
t.en: Signed differences retain direction. Inspection now needs both brightening and darkening. The new absolute-value component retains size for both kinds of change.

desc.zh: 比较两张同尺寸图，输出逐位置、逐通道的绝对差。
desc.en: Compare equal-size images using per-location, per-channel absolute difference.
